escena: on a weathered wooden fishing pier at dawn on an open sea coast; the sun sits just above the horizon at camera left and rakes low across wet, salt-bleached planks with nail heads and frayed coiled rope, a stacked blue plastic fish crate behind her; sea and pale sky fall soft and out of focus, with fine sea mist hanging in the low light.
sujeto: A fisherwoman of about 60, framed from mid-chest up (medium close-up), body turned three-quarters to camera, looking off-frame to the right toward the water; deep-set eyes, weathered sun-damaged skin with deep expression lines, grey hair tied back with loose strands lifted by the wind, a faded orange oilskin jacket with cracked coating at the seams and dried salt marks.
luz: Hard low side light from camera left grazes her face so wrinkles, pores, sunspots and dry lips cast small shadows; the shadow side stays one to two stops darker and unlit.
microdetalle: Individual grey hair strands catch the sunlight; the oilskin shows creases at the elbow and a wet sheen with fine spray droplets on the shoulders. Natural skin color with redness on the cheeks and nose.
camara: Eye-level camera, 85mm feel, shallow depth of field
uso: editorial photograph for the cover of a print reportage
libre_de: text and watermarks, with no glamorization, heavy retouching or studio gloss

escena: in a modern office interior in daytime with a floor-to-ceiling window at camera left; city buildings outside fall soft and slightly overexposed; the edge of a light oak desk with visible grain and a potted fiddle-leaf fig sit in the soft background.
sujeto: A man of about 40, framed from the waist up (medium shot), standing slightly angled to camera with relaxed shoulders, looking straight into the lens with a calm closed-mouth half smile; short dark hair with grey at the temples, light stubble, a navy unstructured wool blazer with visible weave over a white cotton open-collar shirt.
luz: Soft diffused daylight from the large window at camera left with a gentle falloff across the right side of his face and a faint natural bounce from the white walls; low contrast.
microdetalle: Natural fabric folds at the blazer elbows and collar, a soft window catchlight in both eyes.
camara: Eye-level camera, 50mm feel, moderate depth of field so the office reads but stays soft
uso: team page portrait for a corporate website, taken on location
libre_de: text, logos and watermarks, without heavy retouching or a studio backdrop

escena: in a training gym right after a session; worn black rubber flooring with chalk dust and steel weight racks blur behind her; a single row of industrial lights hangs directly overhead.
sujeto: A female athlete of about 25, close-up from the collarbones up, head slightly lowered with her eyes raised to the lens, breathing through parted lips; hair pulled back with damp strands stuck to the temples, a grey sleeveless cotton-blend training top darkened with sweat at the neckline.
luz: Hard top light straight from above puts bright highlights on the forehead, cheekbones and shoulders and deep shadows under the brows, nose and chin.
microdetalle: Individual sweat beads with small specular highlights on the forehead and upper lip, a wet sheen along the neck and collarbones, flushed skin with fine veins at the temples, damp hair strands catching the overhead light.
camara: Eye-level camera, 85mm feel, shallow depth of field
uso: campaign image for a sports club, taken right after training
restriccion_extra: with skin that stays wet and textured
libre_de: text, logos and watermarks, with no glamorization, heavy retouching or airbrushing

escena: in a small home kitchen at night; behind her a window shows only black glass with a faint reflection of the lamp; a worn wooden counter and a single warm pendant lamp hanging over the counter as the only light in the room.
sujeto: A woman of about 30, framed from the waist up (medium shot), leaning back against the counter and holding a matte glazed ceramic mug of tea at chest height with both hands fully visible and wrapped around it, looking down at the rising steam; shoulder-length brown hair, an oversized grey chunky-knit sweater.
luz: One warm tungsten-colored pool of light from the pendant lamp above and slightly in front of her; the rest of the kitchen falls into deep unlit shadow.
microdetalle: Warm highlights on her cheek, knuckles and the rim of the mug, thin steam wisps catching the lamp light, a soft contact shadow where her fingers wrap the mug, loose fibers at the sweater cuffs.
camara: Eye-level camera, 35mm feel, the counter edge leading into the frame
uso: editorial photograph illustrating a lifestyle article
restriccion_extra: with exactly two hands, lit only by the pendant lamp
libre_de: text and watermarks, with no glamorization, heavy retouching or studio gloss

escena: on a concert stage at night; a black background with faint haze and suspended dust; one strong stage light hidden behind the back of his head spills a glow into the haze around his silhouette.
sujeto: A musician of about 70 in strict profile facing the left edge of the frame, head and shoulders to mid-chest, gazing ahead; short white hair, a short white beard, a deeply lined neck, a dark cotton collarless shirt.
luz: Hard backlight from behind and above draws a bright rim along his forehead, nose, lips, individual beard hairs and shoulders while the side of his face toward camera stays mostly in shadow; the haze and dust glow around the rim.
microdetalle: Deep black background fills the upper half of the frame above his head.
camara: Low camera angle looking slightly up at him, 85mm feel
uso: concert poster image with empty dark space above the head for type added later, a live photo
libre_de: text, letters, logos, watermarks and stage equipment

escena: as a full-length studio portrait against a seamless light grey backdrop #C9C9C7 that curves smoothly into the floor; his soft shadow falls on the floor behind him to the right.
sujeto: A Mediterranean man of 25, standing full body from head to shoes in the center of the frame, weight on his left leg, body turned slightly toward camera, looking into the lens with a relaxed closed-mouth expression; olive skin, dark brown eyes, a strong jaw, dark brown hair with premature salt-and-pepper grey combed back, a matching short salt-and-pepper beard, black acetate rectangular glasses. He wears a white Italian cotton dress shirt with a spread collar tucked into light grey tailored wool dress trousers with a sharp crease, a black leather belt with a plain silver buckle, and polished black leather oxford shoes.
luz: One warm key light at 45 degrees from camera left and slightly above his head models the face and the shirt folds, with soft falloff into gentle shadow on his right side and a faint low fill; warm skin tones against the neutral grey.
microdetalle: Natural fabric folds at the elbows and waist, visible cotton weave on the shirt, fine wool texture on the trousers, small specular highlights on the shoe toes and the glasses frame.
camara: Camera at waist height, 85mm feel, the whole body sharp from hair to shoes
uso: full-length portrait for a menswear lookbook, in a studio
restriccion_extra: with the full body from head to shoes inside the frame
